key: F17 Challenge (1993)(Team 17)(Disk 1 of 2).adf boot-block load +$400 to $07E000 (8192 bytes):0:13A0
name: clear_port_bit_and_poll_status
description: Clears one bit of a port control byte chosen by a helper result. If a status bit is set it writes a seven-bit control value and polls a second status bit through a helper until it clears, returning zero on success or minus three when the status is not ready.

key: F17 Challenge (1993)(Team 17)(Disk 1 of 2).adf boot-block load +$400 to $07E000 (8192 bytes):0:13D8
name: clear_control_bits_then_pulse
description: Clears bits one and zero of a control byte, calls a helper, sets bit zero and calls a second helper, making a two-step pulse on that control line.

key: F17 Challenge (1993)(Team 17)(Disk 1 of 2).adf boot-block load +$400 to $07E000 (8192 bytes):0:13DE
name: set_control_bit_then_pulse
description: Sets bit one and clears bit zero of a control byte, calls a helper, sets bit zero and calls a second helper, making a two-step pulse on that control line.

key: F17 Challenge (1993)(Team 17)(Disk 1 of 2).adf boot-block load +$400 to $07E000 (8192 bytes):0:13F2
name: stub_infinite_self_compare_loop
description: Loops while a byte at a fixed offset equals itself, which is always true, so the routine never returns.

key: F17 Challenge (1993)(Team 17)(Disk 1 of 2).adf boot-block load +$400 to $07E000 (8192 bytes):0:1402
name: repeat_helper_by_counter
description: Calls a helper once per count, decrementing a 16-bit counter until it passes zero, so it runs the starting count plus one times.

key: F17 Challenge (1993)(Team 17)(Disk 1 of 2).adf boot-block load +$400 to $07E000 (8192 bytes):0:140A
name: seek_value_by_helper_steps
description: Waits while a status bit is set, reads a helper value and sets or clears bit two of a state byte from its low bit. It then steps a counter by one toward a target value using a helper until the two match.

key: F17 Challenge (1993)(Team 17)(Disk 1 of 2).adf boot-block load +$400 to $07E000 (8192 bytes):0:144E
name: scan_track_buffer_for_sync_words
description: Starts a disk DMA read and scans the track buffer for paired disk sync words 17545, retrying until a sector counter reaches zero or a timeout expires. It returns when the counter reaches zero.

key: F17 Challenge (1993)(Team 17)(Disk 1 of 2).adf boot-block load +$400 to $07E000 (8192 bytes):0:14F6
name: calculate_input_mask_sum
description: Masks an input register and a pointed-to value with a global mask, doubles the pointed-to result, and adds the two together.

key: F17 Challenge (1993)(Team 17)(Disk 1 of 2).adf boot-block load +$400 to $07E000 (8192 bytes):0:1502
name: xor_checksum_longwords
description: Computes an exclusive-or checksum over a run of 32-bit words whose count comes from a register, then masks the result with a second register and returns it.

key: F17 Challenge (1993)(Team 17)(Disk 1 of 2).adf boot-block load +$400 to $07E000 (8192 bytes):0:151E
name: copy_sector_blocks_into_buffer
description: Splits a byte offset into a sector number and an offset within a 512-byte sector, waits on a helper with a retry counter, then copies 512-byte chunks from a table of pointers into the destination buffer until it reaches the buffer end.

key: F17 Challenge (1993)(Team 17)(Disk 1 of 2).adf boot-block load +$400 to $07E000 (8192 bytes):0:158C
name: decrunch_packed_block_from_source
description: Checks the four-byte signature at the source and, when it matches, unpacks the block backward into the destination with a bit buffer, copying literal bytes and back-references.

key: Brian the Lion (Europe) (Demo, Promo)/Brian the Lion (Europe) (Demo, Promo).adf:bootblock:0:000C
name: boot_entry_set_vectors_and_jump
description: Boot-block entry that picks a memory size from a system table, stores a routine address in a trap vector, raises traps zero and one, and then jumps through a pointer to a second-stage routine at a fixed offset.

key: Brian the Lion (Europe) (Demo, Promo)/Brian the Lion (Europe) (Demo, Promo).adf:bootblock:0:0062
name: set_trap_vector_then_jump
description: Stores a routine address in a trap vector, raises trap one, and then jumps through a pointer to a second-stage routine at a fixed offset.

key: Brian the Lion (Europe) (Demo, Promo)/Brian the Lion (Europe) (Demo, Promo).adf:bootblock:0:0076
name: raise_trap_one_then_jump
description: Stores a fixed address in a low-memory slot, raises trap one, then jumps through a pointer to a second-stage routine at a fixed offset.

key: Brian the Lion (Europe) (Demo, Promo)/Brian the Lion (Europe) (Demo, Promo).adf:bootblock:0:009C
name: init_disk_dma_and_interrupts
description: Disables interrupts, clears the background colour, and sets the disk sync word 17545 and the ADKCON control value 38144. It then writes a DMA control value that sets the master DMA enable and configures two CIA port direction registers as outputs.

key: Brian the Lion (Europe) (Demo, Promo)/Brian the Lion (Europe) (Demo, Promo).adf:bootblock:0:00F8
name: compute_track_and_head_for_sector
description: Converts a sector number and count into track and sector-within-track values using eleven sectors per track, stores them, and waits while a disk-busy bit is set. It then writes two drive-control values to a CIA port.

key: Brian the Lion (Europe) (Demo, Promo)/Brian the Lion (Europe) (Demo, Promo).adf:bootblock:0:0140
name: store_track_offset_and_select_drive
description: Stores a value derived from an input word, shifted nine bits and combined with its high part, through a pointer, calls helpers, and writes two drive-control bytes to a CIA port.

key: Brian the Lion (Europe) (Demo, Promo)/Brian the Lion (Europe) (Demo, Promo).adf:bootblock:0:0166
name: stub_immediate_return
description: Empty routine that returns immediately. The fire-button and disk status port is listed but is not read in the body.

key: Brian the Lion (Europe) (Demo, Promo)/Brian the Lion (Europe) (Demo, Promo).adf:bootblock:0:0178
name: issue_disk_command_and_wait
description: Writes zero to one device register and the value 150 to another, then waits until a status bit becomes set. The register offsets belong to the disk controller interface.

key: Brian the Lion (Europe) (Demo, Promo)/Brian the Lion (Europe) (Demo, Promo).adf:bootblock:0:0196
name: step_track_until_target_reached
description: Repeatedly sets or clears bit two of a control byte from the low bit of a counter, reads a new counter value through a helper, and stops when it equals the stored target. It then stores that value.
